literal: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande
idiomatic: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande

literal: Li Hun, styled Jichu, was a man of Bairen in Zhao commandery.
idiomatic: Li Hun, styled Jichu, was a man of Bairen in Zhao commandery.

literal: His great-grandfather Ling was Duke of Julu under Wei.
idiomatic: His great-grandfather Ling was duke of Julu under Wei.

literal: His father Zun was staff officer of the Eastern Campaigning Headquarters in Jizhou under Wei; when Prince Jingzhao Yu of Jingzhao rose in revolt in Jizhou, he met disaster and was killed.
idiomatic: His father Zun was staff officer of the eastern campaigning headquarters in Jizhou under Wei; when Prince Jingzhao Yu rose in revolt in Jizhou, he met disaster and was killed.

literal: Because his father died in the prince's service, Hun was appointed attendant within the yellow gates.
idiomatic: Because his father died in the prince's service, Hun was appointed attendant within the yellow gates.

literal: When troubles multiplied on all sides, he resigned on grounds of illness and sought appointment as staff officer of the Eastern Campaigning Headquarters in Qingzhou.
idiomatic: When troubles multiplied on all sides, he resigned on grounds of illness and sought appointment as staff officer of the eastern campaigning headquarters in Qingzhou.

literal: Together with Xing Shao of Hejian and Wang Xin of Beihai, he all supported their aged mothers and took wives and children on the same journey to Qing and Qi.
idiomatic: Together with Xing Shao of Hejian and Wang Xin of Beihai, they all supported their aged mothers and took wives and children on the same journey to Qing and Qi.

literal: Before long Erzhu Rong entered Luoyang and the gentry were wiped out.
idiomatic: Before long Erzhu Rong entered Luoyang and the gentry were wiped out.

literal: Those who commented considered that he had shown foresight.
idiomatic: Commentators held that he had read the times aright.

literal: At the beginning of Yong'an he was appointed attendant cavalier in regular attendance.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Yong'an he was appointed attendant cavalier in regular attendance.

literal: In the Putai era, Cui Sheke rebelled in Hai and Dai and besieged Qingzhou.
idiomatic: In the Putai era, Cui Sheke rebelled in Hai and Dai and besieged Qingzhou.

literal: An edict appointed Hun general of the eastern campaign and director of the ministry of justice, with mobile headquarters to go to the rescue.
idiomatic: An edict appointed Hun general of the eastern campaign and director of the ministry of justice, with mobile headquarters to go to the rescue.

literal: Sheke had many veteran officers who were schemers; each city kept its own defenses, securing the walls and clearing the countryside.
idiomatic: Sheke had many veteran officers full of schemes; each city held its own ground, securing the walls and clearing the countryside.

literal: Opinion at the time was divided.
idiomatic: Opinion at the time was divided.

literal: Hun said: "Sheke is the root of the bandits; the siege has already passed a new and full moon.
idiomatic: Hun said, "Sheke is the root of the rebels; the siege has already passed a full month.

literal: A mob gathered in a day can easily be broken apart.
idiomatic: A mob gathered in a day can easily be broken apart.

literal: If we pick crack troops, gag them for a night assault, strike straight for the camp, and take them unawares, in a trice we can capture and destroy them.
idiomatic: If we pick crack troops, gag them for a night assault, strike straight for the camp, and take them unawares, in a trice we can capture and destroy them.

literal: Once Sheke is taken, the commanderies can be settled by proclamation alone.
idiomatic: Once Sheke is taken, the commanderies can be settled by proclamation alone.

literal: Why insist on storming the city in the heat and wearing down the troops?
idiomatic: Why insist on storming the city in the heat and wearing down the troops?

literal: " The generals hesitated; Hun decided to proceed anyway.
idiomatic: " The generals hesitated; Hun decided to proceed anyway.

literal: Before dawn they reached below the walls; the rebel host scattered in alarm; Sheke was captured alive; his head was sent to Luoyang.
idiomatic: Before dawn they reached below the walls; the rebel host scattered in alarm; Sheke was captured alive and his head was sent to Luoyang.

literal: The coastal regions were pacified.
idiomatic: The coastal regions were pacified.

literal: Later he was appointed grand master for illuminating government and concurrent regular attendant, envoy to Liang.
idiomatic: Later he was appointed grand master for illuminating government and concurrent regular attendant, and sent as envoy to Liang.

literal: Emperor Wu of Liang said to him: "Descendants of Boyang — the longer, the more they flourish; men of the Zhao Li clan are truly numerous today.
idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Liang said to him, "Descendants of Boyang — the longer the line runs, the more it flourishes; men of the Zhao Li clan are truly numerous today.

literal: The attendant once served as a commander; now again you fill an envoy's post — civil and military alike unbroken: how fitting in such a man.
idiomatic: You once served as a commander; now again you fill an envoy's post — civil and military alike unbroken. How fitting in such a man.

literal: " On return he became administrator of Dong commandery; he was recalled on charges of corruption.
idiomatic: " On his return he became administrator of Dong commandery; he was recalled on charges of corruption.

literal: Gao Cheng had warriors seize and bring him in; Hun spoke up boldly: "Does the general still treat the worthy with courtesy today?
idiomatic: Gao Cheng had warriors seize and bring him in; Hun spoke up boldly, "Does the general still treat the worthy with courtesy today?

literal: " Gao Cheng laughed and let him go.
idiomatic: " Gao Cheng laughed and let him go.

literal: At the beginning of Tianbao he was appointed junior tutor to the heir apparent.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianbao he was appointed junior tutor to the heir apparent.

literal: At the time Xing Shao was junior preceptor and Yang Yin junior tutor; commentators took it as an honor.
idiomatic: At the time Xing Shao was junior preceptor and Yang Yin junior tutor; commentators took it as an honor.

literal: Because he took part in the rites and regulations of the dynastic transition, he was granted the title Baron of Jingyang county.
idiomatic: Because he took part in the rites and regulations of the dynastic transition, he was granted the title baron of Jingyang county.

literal: He helped revise the Linzhi Code.
idiomatic: He helped revise the Linzhi Code.

literal: Soon he was appointed governor of Haizhou.
idiomatic: Soon he was appointed governor of Haizhou.

literal: The local people rebelled and together attacked the prefectural city.
idiomatic: The local people rebelled and together attacked the prefectural city.

literal: The city had much stone and no wells; they regularly drank seawater.
idiomatic: The city had much stone and no wells; they regularly drank seawater.

literal: The rebels cut off their routes.
idiomatic: The rebels cut off their routes.

literal: Within the city there was already a pool; after long drought it had dried up, but one morning heaven sent rain and springs gushed forth in flood.
idiomatic: Within the city there was already a pool; after long drought it had dried up, but one morning heaven sent rain and springs gushed forth in flood.

literal: The rebels took it for a miracle and scattered in alarm at once.
idiomatic: The rebels took it for a miracle and scattered in alarm at once.

literal: Hun urged on his officers and soldiers and captured and beheaded the ringleaders.
idiomatic: Hun urged on his officers and soldiers and captured and beheaded the ringleaders.

literal: Hun's concubine Lady Guo meddled in government at the prefecture and took bribes; on that charge he was dismissed from office.
idiomatic: Hun's concubine Lady Guo meddled in government at the prefecture and took bribes; on that charge he was dismissed from office.

literal: He died.
idiomatic: He died.

literal: His son Zhan, styled Chuyuan.
idiomatic: His son Zhan, styled Chuyuan.

literal: He ranged widely in letters and histories and had the family's manner.
idiomatic: He ranged widely in letters and histories and had the family's manner.

literal: He served as attendant to the heir apparent, concurrent regular attendant, and deputy envoy on a mission to Chen.
idiomatic: He served as attendant to the heir apparent, concurrent regular attendant, and deputy envoy on a mission to Chen.

literal: He inherited the title Baron of Jingyang county.
idiomatic: He inherited the title baron of Jingyang county.

literal: Hun and his brothers Hui and Wei had all been chief envoys on missions to Liang; Zhan again served as deputy envoy — hence men of Zhao commandery called them the Gate of Four Envoys.
idiomatic: Hun and his brothers Hui and Wei had all been chief envoys on missions to Liang; Zhan again served as deputy envoy — hence men of Zhao commandery called them the Gate of Four Envoys.

literal: Hui, styled Jingwen.
idiomatic: Hui, styled Jingwen.

literal: At age six he himself wished to enter school; his family, by chance observing a taboo of the year, made an appointment and would not allow it.
idiomatic: At age six he himself wished to enter school; his family, observing a taboo of the year by chance, made an appointment and would not allow it.

literal: He watched his elder cousin sister between brush and inkstone and would steal use of them; before long he had mastered the Jijiuzhang.
idiomatic: He watched his elder cousin sister between brush and inkstone and would steal use of them; before long he had mastered the Jijiuzhang.

literal: Inside and outside the family marveled at him, considering him no ordinary child.
idiomatic: Inside and outside the family marveled at him, considering him no ordinary child.

literal: When grown, his bearing was dignified and imposing, his spirit bright and outstanding.
idiomatic: When grown, his bearing was dignified and imposing, his spirit bright and outstanding.

literal: Xing Yan of Hejian — Hui's maternal uncle — conversed in pure talk with Hui and admired his loftiness.
idiomatic: Xing Yan of Hejian — Hui's maternal uncle — conversed in pure talk with Hui and admired his loftiness.

literal: He often praised him: "As if parting the clouds and mist, as if facing pearls and jade — the hopes of the clan seat rest on this nephew.
idiomatic: He often praised him, "As if parting the clouds and mist, as if facing pearls and jade — the hopes of the clan seat rest on this nephew.

literal: " Prince of Qi Xiao Baoyin brought him in as chief clerk and recorder, put him in charge of memorials and proclamations, and treated him with the courtesy due a guest and friend.
idiomatic: " Prince of Qi Xiao Baoyin brought him in as chief clerk and recorder, put him in charge of memorials and proclamations, and treated him with the courtesy due a guest and friend.

literal: Grand Secretary Gao Yong summoned him as attendant gentleman; he was called to Luoyang.
idiomatic: Grand Secretary Gao Yong summoned him as attendant gentleman; he was called to Luoyang.

literal: At the time an edict had the attendant-in-ordinary Prince Xihe of the Western River, Secretary Director Chang Jing, and ten Confucian scholars compile the Five Rites; Hui and Wang Yi of Taiyuan together took charge of military rites.
idiomatic: At the time an edict had the attendant-in-ordinary Prince Xihe of the Western River, Secretary Director Chang Jing, and ten Confucian scholars compile the Five Rites; Hui and Wang Yi of Taiyuan together took charge of military rites.

literal: Emperor Jing of Wei lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety and the Record of Rites at the Xianyang Hall; Hui and his cousin Qian, Pei Bomo, Wei Shou, Lu Yuanming, and others were all recorders and discussants.
idiomatic: Emperor Jing of Wei lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety and the Record of Rites at the Xianyang Hall; Hui and his cousin Qian, Pei Bomo, Wei Shou, Lu Yuanming, and others were all recorders and discussants.

literal: He had long excelled at letters; he was especially able to transmit and receive; in compiling and stitching together discussions, his selections were worth viewing.
idiomatic: He had long excelled at letters; he was especially able to transmit and receive; in compiling and stitching together discussions, his selections were worth viewing.

literal: At the beginning of Tianping, Gao Cheng employed him as staff officer to the chancellor.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianping, Gao Cheng employed him as staff officer to the chancellor.

literal: Whenever court adjourned, civil and military officials would all assemble and debate before the royal court; he was regularly made to open the discussion, first among the officials.
idiomatic: Whenever court adjourned, civil and military officials would all assemble and debate before the royal court; he was regularly made to open the discussion, first among the officials.

literal: His words were clear and correct, his bearing altogether elegant; listeners were awed.
idiomatic: His words were clear and correct, his bearing altogether elegant; listeners were awed.

literal: At the beginning of Wuding he was concurrent regular attendant and chief envoy on a mission to Liang.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Wuding he was concurrent regular attendant and chief envoy on a mission to Liang.

literal: Emperor Wu of Liang asked Hui: "Where is Chancellor Gao now?
idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Liang asked Hui, "Where is Chancellor Gao now?

literal: " Hui said: "He is now at Jinyang, sternly repelling border raiders.
idiomatic: " Hui said, "He is now at Jinyang, sternly repelling border raiders.

literal: " Emperor Wu said: "What is Black Badger's appearance like?
idiomatic: " Emperor Wu said, "What is Black Badger's appearance like?

literal: What strategy does Chancellor Gao pursue?
idiomatic: What strategy does Chancellor Gao pursue?

literal: " Hui said: "Black Badger is a stray spirit in the west, loathed by men and spirits alike; year after year brings fierce calamity and the people yearn for their homeland.
idiomatic: " Hui said, "Black Badger is a stray spirit in the west, loathed by men and spirits alike; year after year brings fierce calamity and the people yearn for their homeland.

literal: The chancellor's stratagems are unmatched in the age; he gathers sharp blades and watches for an opening — attacking the benighted to take the doomed — victory cannot be far.
idiomatic: The chancellor's stratagems are unmatched in the age; he gathers sharp blades and watches for an opening — attacking the benighted to take the doomed — victory cannot be far.

literal: " Emperor Wu said: "As you say — excellent.
idiomatic: " Emperor Wu said, "As you say — excellent.

literal: " With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said: "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen.
idiomatic: " With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said, "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen.

literal: " Hui said: "Though what you issue from is remote, you should share one character with Che Qianqiu.
idiomatic: " Hui said, "Though what you issue from is remote, you should share one character with Che Qianqiu.

literal: " The whole company laughed aloud.
idiomatic: " The whole company laughed aloud.

literal: Envoys who came before and after all sent letters opening relations and seeking trade; Hui alone kept to purity and loftiness — the men of Liang respected his integrity.
idiomatic: Envoys who came before and after all sent letters opening relations and seeking trade; Hui alone kept to purity and loftiness — the men of Liang respected his integrity.

literal: On his return he was appointed general who pacifies the south and inner administrator of Gaoyang.
idiomatic: On his return he was appointed general who pacifies the south and inner administrator of Gaoyang.

literal: Within the commandery there had long been fierce beasts; the people often suffered from them.
idiomatic: Within the commandery there had long been fierce beasts; the people often suffered from them.

literal: Hui wished to build a cage-trap; the beast thereupon died in a fight.
idiomatic: Hui wished to build a cage-trap; the beast thereupon died in a fight.

literal: All considered it an effect of transforming influence and asked to report it upward.
idiomatic: All considered it an effect of transforming influence and asked to report it upward.

literal: Hui said: "The fierce beast died fighting — that was mere chance; if I greedily claim it as merit, people will peer into me.
idiomatic: Hui said, "The fierce beast died fighting — that was mere chance; if I greedily claim it as merit, people will peer into me.

literal: " In the end he would not listen.
idiomatic: " In the end he would not listen.

literal: Gao Huan toured the commanderies eastward; west of Yingzhou city he halted his horse and stood long; he sent word of comfort: "When I was in Jin, I knew that among the governors east of the mountains only you alone applied your mind.
idiomatic: Gao Huan toured the commanderies eastward; west of Yingzhou city he halted his horse and stood long; he sent word of comfort, "When I was in Jin, I knew that among the governors east of the mountains only you alone applied your mind.

literal: Now that I have entered your territory and observed the winds, it is as I heard.
idiomatic: Now that I have entered your territory and observed the winds, it is as I heard.

literal: Only see that you begin well and end well — your rank will rise beyond the ordinary.
idiomatic: Only see that you begin well and end well — your rank will rise beyond the ordinary.

literal: " Administrator of Hejian Cui Mou relied on the power of his younger brother Xian and begged from Hui elk horns and pigeon feathers.
idiomatic: " Administrator of Hejian Cui Mou relied on the power of his younger brother Xian and begged from Hui elk horns and pigeon feathers.

literal: Hui replied in a letter: "The pigeon has six pinions — in flight it pierces the sky; the elk has four legs — in running it soon reaches the sea.
idiomatic: Hui replied in a letter, "The pigeon has six pinions — in flight it pierces the sky; the elk has four legs — in running it soon reaches the sea.

literal: This humble officer's flesh is slack and lazy, his hands and feet slow and dull; I cannot chase what flies or pursue what runs, and go far to serve a flatterer.
idiomatic: This humble officer's flesh is slack and lazy, his hands and feet slow and dull; I cannot chase what flies or pursue what runs, and go far to serve a flatterer.

literal: " At the time Gao Cheng had Xian select the chief clerk of the ministry of rites; Xian recommended Hui, but in the end it did not come to pass — all said it was because of this letter.
idiomatic: " At the time Gao Cheng had Xian select the chief clerk of the ministry of rites; Xian recommended Hui, but in the end it did not come to pass — all said it was because of this letter.

literal: At the beginning of Tianbao he was chief clerk on the right of the ministry of rites.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianbao he was chief clerk on the right of the ministry of rites.

literal: Hui's nature was square and weighty; he never hurried to serve the powerful — for this reason he long remained suppressed and obscure.
idiomatic: Hui's nature was square and weighty; he never hurried to serve the powerful — for this reason he long remained suppressed and obscure.

literal: He died.
idiomatic: He died.

literal: He was posthumously made governor of Southern Qingzhou; his posthumous title was Jing.
idiomatic: He was posthumously made governor of Southern Qingzhou; his posthumous title was Jing.

literal: Gongxu, styled Mushu, was the son of Ji, Hun's clansman elder brother.
idiomatic: Gongxu, styled Mushu, was the son of Ji, Hun's clansman on the elder-brother line.

literal: By nature clever and keen, he broadly mastered the classics and their commentaries.
idiomatic: By nature clever and keen, he broadly mastered the classics and their commentaries.

literal: At the end of Wei he was staff officer in Jizhou; he left office on grounds of illness.
idiomatic: At the end of Wei he was staff officer in Jizhou; he left office on grounds of illness.

literal: Later he was summoned as attendant censor but did not come; he died.
idiomatic: Later he was summoned as attendant censor but did not come; he died.

literal: Gongxu was withdrawn and delighted in the Way, heedless of worldly affairs — hence he vowed in his heart not to serve.
idiomatic: Gongxu was withdrawn and delighted in the Way, heedless of worldly affairs — hence he vowed in his heart not to serve.

literal: He was especially skilled in yin-yang lore and apocryphal charts.
idiomatic: He was especially skilled in yin-yang lore and apocryphal charts.

literal: He once told people: "Whenever I observe the astral territory of Qi, its fortune and virtue are not great; the state's dynastic span will end at four-seven.
idiomatic: He once told people, "Whenever I observe the astral territory of Qi, its fortune and virtue are not great; the state's dynastic span will end at four-seven.

literal: " When Qi fell, it was twenty-eight years from the first year of Tianbao.
idiomatic: " When Qi fell, it was twenty-eight years from the first year of Tianbao.

literal: Gongxu lived in seclusion awaiting his time and by nature loved to write books; he composed Dianyan in ten juan, also composed Zhiyi in five juan, Sangfu zhangju in one juan, Gujin lüeji in twenty juan, Xuanzi in five juan, and Zhaoyu in thirteen juan — all circulated in the world.
idiomatic: Gongxu lived in seclusion awaiting his time and by nature loved to write books; he composed Dianyan in ten juan, also Zhiyi in five juan, Sangfu zhangju in one juan, Gujin lüeji in twenty juan, Xuanzi in five juan, and Zhaoyu in thirteen juan — all circulated in the world.

literal: Li Yu, styled Daofan, was a man of Chengji in Longxi — fifth-generation descendant of Li Hao, Martial and Illustrious King of Liang.
idiomatic: Li Yu, styled Daofan, was a man of Chengji in Longxi — fifth-generation descendant of Li Hao, Martial and Illustrious King of Liang.
